Multi-stage Builds
Multiple FROM stages separate build tooling from the final runtime image.
Build stage එJක් compiler සහ development tools තිJයනවා. Runtime stage එකට අවශ්‍ය
compiled files විතරක් copy කරනවා. Final image එක සැහැල්ලු කරන්න පුළුවන්.
Compile a Vite frontend in Node, then serve dist from NGINX.

Build stage: Node + · tools + source Compiled dist/ Runtime stage: NGINX + · dist/ · Read the diagram: Only compiled output is copied into the final runtime stage. · ඉහළ visual එJක් components සහ ඒවා අතර සම්බන්ධය බලන්න. Build stage එJක් compiler සහ development · tools තිJයනවා.

FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
Expected result: Final image uses NGINX plus compiled assets, not the Node build toolchain.
Reduce final image size and unnecessary runtime dependencies.
Practice: Identify which files must cross from build stage to runtime stage.
